snippets.title: Ep 86: Yann LeCun on Leaving Meta, Breaking The LLM Paradigm, & Why Hinton is Wrong
snippets.takeaway: Ep 86: Yann LeCun on Leaving Meta, Breaking The LLM Paradigm, & Why Hinton is Wrong. A world model, at a very general level, is something that allows an agentic system to...
snippets.summary: A world model, at a very general level, is something that allows an agentic system to anticipate the consequences of its own actions. LLMs do not have the ability to predict the consequences of their actions, and they do not have any planning abilities, because inference is by predicting the next token. And so it made sense to really do a startup around it and sort of go to into high gear, you know, and pushing that.
